name: Eurocopter EC135 T2+
summary: Light twin-engine helicopter with a bearingless main rotor and an enclosed "Fenestron" tail rotor, widely used for air ambulance and police work.

specs.engine_type: Turbomeca Arrius 2B2 or Pratt & Whitney PW206B2

verify.note: The rotor head tops out at 3.53 m, matching the published 3.51 m, but the model’s tail fin reaches 4.08 m.

tail-rotor.Type: Fenestron, ducted fan with unevenly spaced blades to cut noise
